english.title: Interested person fail to give information re premises in designated high street / town centre
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person who appeared to **(..SPECIFY LOCAL AUTHORITY..) to have an interest in land in which premises

(A)_[on a designated high street]_
(B)_[within a designated town centre]_

were comprised, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), failed in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..) without reasonable excuse to comply with a requirement under section 210(2) of the Levelling-up and Regeneration Act 2023 to give information about those premises to that local authority by the time and in the manner in which the information was required to be given
english.legislation: Contrary to section 210(7)(a) and (8) of the Levelling-up and Regeneration Act 2023.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being an interested person
failed without reasonable excuse
to comply with a requirement under section 210(2)
